description: Accessible floating tooltip built on Radix UI Tooltip, displaying short contextual text on hover or focus. Requires TooltipProvider at the root and supports configurable side offset and animation.
useCases: Icon button label tooltip in toolbar (e.g., Save, Delete, Preview)
Truncated text full-value tooltip in table cells
Keyboard shortcut hint tooltip on hover over action buttons
Disabled button explanation tooltip for unavailable actions
